proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ S f L a hc ha hf
  have slope : ∀ x : E, Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ • (f (a + t • (x - a)) - f a))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (L (x - a))) := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a + t • (x - a)) (x - a) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (x - a)).const_add a
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt f L (a + (0 : ℝ) • (x - a)) := by simpa using hf
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (a + t • (x - a))) (L (x - a)) 0 :=
      h2.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) h1
    simpa using h3.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have e : ∀ (x : E) (t : ℝ), (1 - t) • a + t • x = a + t • (x - a) := by
    intro x t
    rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  constructor
  · intro hmin x hx
    refine ge_of_tendsto (slope x) ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)] with t ht
    have hm := hc.1 ha hx (sub_nonneg.2 ht.2.le) ht.1.le (by ring)
    rw [e] at hm
    have h := isMinOn_iff.1 hmin _ hm
    exact smul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 ht.1.le) (sub_nonneg.2 h)
  · intro h
    rw [isMinOn_iff]
    intro x hx
    have hle : L (x - a) ≤ f x - f a := by
      refine le_of_tendsto (slope x) ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)] with t ht
      have h' := hc.2 ha hx (sub_nonneg.2 ht.2.le) ht.1.le (by ring)
      rw [e] at h'
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h' ⊢
      rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ ht.1]
      linarith
    linarith [h x hx]
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (S : Set E) (f : E → ℝ) (L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : E), ConvexOn ℝ S f → a ∈ S → HasFDerivAt f L a → (IsMinOn f S a ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ L (x - a))
